strings.app.name: Ethel
strings.app.offline_explain: This machine has no internet connection and cannot make one. Everything here is already installed.
strings.login.title: Who is studying?
strings.login.name: Your name
strings.login.pin_help: Four digits or more. This keeps your progress separate from other students on this machine.
strings.enrol.title: Tell me where you study
strings.enrol.one_only: You can only study one programme at a time. You can change later, but your progress on this one is set aside when you do.
strings.install.title: Loading your courses onto this machine
strings.install.explain: Nothing is downloaded from the internet. Your courses are copied from the material already stored here.
strings.placement.title: Before we start
strings.placement.explain: A short test so I know where to begin. There is no pass mark. If you don't know, say so - a wrong answer here saves us both time later.
strings.ask.title: Ask me anything from your courses
strings.ask.refused: I don't know. That isn't in your course material, and I won't guess at it.
strings.plan.title: Your study plan
strings.voice.unavailable: No voice is installed for this language on this machine.
